content:
people-ops-bot: Announcement: please welcome Nora Elbaz, Senior Director of Observability, joining Redwood Inference today. Onboarding docs and intro meeting details below.

Clara Ruiz: :tada: Super excited to announce Nora is joining as Sr Director, Observability. She'll own observability strategy across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private products. Welcome, Nora!

Nora Elbaz: Thanks everyone! Really excited to be here. Looking forward to meeting the teams — immediate focus is instrumentation backlog, dashboards, and incident playbooks.

Lizzy Mendoza: Welcome Nora! Quick Q: will you be taking over retention/pricing conversations for logs & metrics, or is that staying with Product?

Nora Elbaz: Lizzy 10: Good Q — observability platform strategy remains a partnership with Product. I'll lead technical roadmap and vendor integrations; Product will continue to lead pricing/packaging decisions.

Diego Morales: Congrats Nora! Operational note: can you prioritize end-to-end traces for serving runtime? We've seen blindspots during multi-model rollouts.

Nora Elbaz: Diego 10: Yes. Traces and distributed sampling are top of my first 30-day list. I'll sync with runtime and SRE next week.

Priya Natarajan: Welcome! From a people ops angle: Nora will report to Clara. We'll post org chart update and new role profile in #careers later today.

Clara Ruiz: Backfill rounds: we'll run an internal hiring tranche for two IC roles (Observability PM and Senior SW Eng) and an external search for a Staff SWE focused on telemetry ingestion. People Ops will share reqs.

people-ops-bot: Action: people-ops to open internal requisitions for Observability PM & Sr SW Eng. External req for Staff SWE to be posted by EOD Friday.

Evan Carter: Congrats Nora. A couple asks: (1) can we aim for a 2-week survey of current dashboards that are mission-critical for latency/availability? (2) please nominate two owners who can approve dashboard changes during the hiring window.

Nora Elbaz: Evan 10: Yes on the survey. I'll publish a short audit template by Monday. For owners during hiring I'll nominate Diego (runtime metrics) and Tomas Alvarez (infra metrics) for approval.

Tomas Alvarez: Happy to cover infra metrics approvals while we recruit. Also I'll coordinate with Eng Infra to freeze any major metrics schema changes for two weeks.

Diego Morales: I'll take runtime metrics approvals. Also flagging that the Dedicated fleet trace agent upgrade is scheduled next week  we may want to gate that on compatibility tests.

Clara Ruiz: Noted. Decision: pause noncritical telemetry upgrades until Nora's audit is complete (2 weeks), except security patches. We'll communicate to eng teams now.

Priya Natarajan: I'll draft the org update and internal FAQ: reporting line, hiring plan, and who to contact for dashboard access. Will post in this thread and #eng tomorrow.

Nora Elbaz: Thanks Priya. Also planning a 30-min intro Q&A next Wed (10am PT) to surface high-level priorities and listen to pain points. Invite to follow.

people-ops-bot: Calendar invite: "Welcome Nora - Observability Q&A" created by people-ops-bot for next Wed 10:00 AM PT. RSVP with :thumbsup: or :wave:.

Evan Carter: Thanks. One operational ask: can we get a short runbook for incident ownership handoffs during the two-week freeze? We had ambiguities last month.

Nora Elbaz: I'll work with Diego & Tomas on a clear incident ownership map and publish it before the Q&A.

Clara Ruiz: TL;DR action items: Priya posts org update + FAQ; people-ops opens reqs; Nora publishes audit template and incident ownership map; pause noncritical telemetry upgrades for 2 weeks; intro Q&A next Wed. Welcome again, Nora!

Nora Elbaz: Appreciate the warm welcome. Looking forward to working with you all.

people-ops-bot: Please react with :wave: to welcome Nora and confirm you'll attend the Q&A if you plan to.
